answer: An agent market can use a climbing stake ladder: a new identity starts at the nadir with zero voting weight and must stake 50 coins on a ledge contract for 30 days while completing one verified task. Only after that work is it promoted to a knoll rank that can vote or claim rewards. One honest agent needs one 50-coin stake and one task, but an attacker wanting 200 voting identities must lock 10,000 coins for a month and finish 200 verified tasks, and any copied task forfeits the whole stake, so mass cloning becomes expensive instead of free.
